newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz sees more bank sales agreements.
newsitem.headline: Allianz sees more bank sales agreements.

text.p: German insurer Allianz AG Holding said on Wednesday it planned to increase its distribution agrements with banks worldwide in 1997 and was testing more options in direct insurance.

In the text of a speech to be delivered to a news conference, chairman Henning Schulte-Noelle said Allianz wanted to improve its profile as a multi-channel distributor of products this year "through banking co-operations in all important countries."
The company was testing direct distribution methods in the U.S. and U.K., he added, while its Italian unit RAS had begun a direct service.
"In the current year and in the years to come we will use the possibilities of all distribution channels to meet demands of the relevant market situation and client needs," he said.
